visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Combined Case Is Checked Last
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 15 should give FizzBuzz, but the program gives Fizz for it.

solution.explanation: An elif chain stops at the first true condition. Every multiple of 15 is also a multiple of 3, so the Fizz branch catches it first. Test the most specific condition first.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz\s*(?![\s\S])
